verdict.rationale: Puzzle documents its own API for programmatic, platform-to-platform integrations and embedded accounting, which is a non-UI way to drive the product. However, nothing documents headless or CI-style operation for an individual user: no CLI, no tokens for scripted runs, no CI guidance, and the OpenAPI probes returned 404. The MCP integration is conversational use through Claude, not headless automation. Missing for 10: documented headless/CLI or CI usage, public API reference/OpenAPI spec, API access for individual users (not just platform partners), independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation

citations.quote: Our API was originally architected for deep platform-to-platform integrations.
